title: The FarmTree Platform
excerpt: Design, compare and communicate agroforestry scenarios with connected scientific, environmental and economic project intelligence.
body: FarmTree combines site, climate, soil, species and management information to create time-based agroforestry scenarios. Use it to compare options, keep assumptions visible and prepare decisions for field and specialist review.

title: Proof Stories
excerpt: Explore four evidence themes grounded in FarmTree's published capabilities and project experience.
body: These stories explain how FarmTree supports carbon planning, farm-value modelling, cocoa scenario work and water-resilience questions. They do not claim guaranteed or independently verified outcomes.

title: Customer Segments

body: The same model can support different decisions. Start with your organisation's question, available evidence and responsibilities, then choose an appropriately scoped workflow.

title: Cocoa Focus

body: FarmTree can support cocoa programmes in comparing shade-tree systems, renewal timing, production, farmer value, carbon and other indicators. Local evidence and field review remain essential.
